release_name: Live TV v3.6 — Mobile Remote Hub, Channel Guide & In-App Updates
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 Mobile Remote Home Page: Complete channel guide on your phone with live search, category pills & 2-column channel cards
⚡ Remote Software Updates: Check for Live TV updates directly from your mobile remote and trigger one-click Mac updates with real-time progress
Now Playing Sticky Bar: Live channel thumbnail, play/pause, prev/next, mute and PiP right from your smartphone
Dual-View Mobile Navigation: Seamless toggle between Channel Guide (Home) and Ergonomic D-Pad TV Controller
Favorites Sync on Mobile: Star favorite channels directly from your phone remote
Fixed Picture-in-Picture on macOS: Native borderless floating mini-player pinned to corner across all Spaces & apps
On-hover PiP controls: Quick restore back to full player (P), live channel title, play/pause, next/prev, and mute
Added Discovery Bangla, Discovery Kids Bangla, Discovery Science HD, Discovery Turbo HD
2,989 total live channels with 3-server instant auto-failover
